reviews.t: Wonderful place of worship true preaching and teaching about the principles of a relationship with the LORD.
Good place to worship! Good people!
Great place to worship!!! Gods house!!!

Mills Chapel is a wonderful church with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. It’s a place where you can grow in your faith, build meaningful relationships, and feel at home. I’m thankful to be part of a church that welcomes everyone and makes people feel like they belong!
